QUOTE: Archive action | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally, keeps the channel | Removes the current user from the channel locally; WebSocket channel-archived event | ... | Only updates `delete_at` | If the user is in that channel, kicks them out (`CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes membership
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when viewing is disabled, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current one. When viewing is enabled, the channel is kept and `delete_at` is set, which marks it deleted.
